verdict.rationale: Bento's API supports reviewing broadcast history and creating campaigns (bento-docs-34), and highlights tying revenue back to emails/flows (bento-docs-6), suggesting some campaign performance data is retrievable via API, but there is no explicit documentation of dedicated analytics/metrics endpoints (open rates, click rates, flow performance stats) or guidance for exporting data into a warehouse/BI tool. Missing for 10: dedicated performance-metrics API endpoints for flows, explicit open/click/conversion stats via API, and documented warehouse/dashboard export patterns.
